scenario: Strings are Unicode codepoint sequences per LSTR.9.1 — String fields hold Unicode codepoint sequences. Pin: a schema with a String field used in a where-clause equality compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Msg m where m.text == "hello"
->
    log info "matched"
